156|     second and third arguments specify the dictionary of globals to use and the
157|     module name. The globals dictionary defaults to ``(local)`` and the module
158|     name defaults to the name of the current module.

160|        => (eval '(print "Hello World"))

164|     form first:
165| 
166|        => (eval (read-str "(+ 1 1)"))
167|        2"""

169|         frame = inspect.stack()[1][0]
170|         namespace = inspect.getargvalues(frame).locals
171|     if module_name is None:
